Around [[3643 BBY]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]] undertook a '''mission''' to [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to save [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cin Tykan]] from the [[Dark Plague]], using the [[shielding technique]] learned from the [[Noetikon]] devices.
